title: Gummi controls, weapons and editor: native follow-up
status: Source, tests, catalog and reports frozen; independent review complete without blocker; root integration pending; no live test

claims.Finding: Computes movement factor clamp(1 + mobilityBonus/100,0.1,3); negative bonus is first multiplied by systemparam row0 float+16.
claims.Limitations: A raw negative bonus is not itself an exact percent reduction; the loaded parameter matters.

claims.Finding: Computes roll-impulse factor clamp(1 + state+40/100,0,3).
claims.Limitations: Affects impulse paths; it does not shorten the roll duration or remove invulnerability ownership.

claims.Finding: Consumes mobility factor for maximum lateral speed, acceleration and deceleration. Integrates normal motion plus a decaying roll impulse. Roll time1512 decreases by154430 ticks and clears relevant roll flags on expiry.
claims.Limitations: Engine ticks are not established milliseconds; forcing the countdown would also affect several roll/impact flags.

claims.Finding: Inputbit0x400 while no active roll bit0x80 initializes roll impulse/timers, effect and temporary immunity. Also handles formation, sword request and drain/shield input.
claims.Limitations: No physical controller button is inferred from this internal input bit alone. Full trigger has effect/resource dependencies.

claims.Finding: GUN update uses requestbit1, disabledbit2, burstbit4, burst interval128/countdown132 and firing delay136/countdown140. It calls virtual shot slot16 and manages an effect instance.
claims.Limitations: These are per-gun cadence states, not evidence of a universal player overheat gauge.

claims.Finding: DRAIN phase2 waits30ticks, then phases3/4 initialize and absorb enemy shots; phase5 fires and phase6 returns to ready phase1.
claims.Limitations: Drain/shield phase writes alone would skip enemy-shot iteration, firing and effects.

claims.Finding: Aggregates installed ship/ability contributions into PLAYER_STATE, including movement36, roll40, lock-on44 and special-charge multiplier52; publishes GUMISHIP+200 state backlink.
claims.Limitations: Rebuilding stats can overwrite one-time trainer values. Underlying editor parts and save data are unchanged by the new controls.

claims.Finding: HISTORY destructor frees a352064-byte object through the Gummi menu allocator when deletion flag1 is set.
claims.Limitations: Allocator/layout dependency for editor lifetime; not a gameplay operation.

claims.Finding: COST destructor frees the200-byte cost widget using the menu allocator.
claims.Limitations: The published cost global is not itself sufficient ownership proof.

claims.Finding: Adds signed EDX to PLAYER_STATE+40 using RCX state; no allocation, event or callback.
claims.Limitations: Caller must prevent signed addition overflow; the trainer calculates a checked target-minus-current delta.

claims.Finding: Adds signed EDX to PLAYER_STATE+44 using RCX state, with no other writes.
claims.Limitations: The field controls lock-on delay formula; it is not a universal gun firing-speed multiplier.

claims.Finding: Adds signed EDX to PLAYER_STATE+36 using RCX state, with no other writes.
claims.Limitations: Runtime aggregated bonus only; does not modify installed parts or save records.

claims.Finding: Converts signed state+44 lock-on bonus to float inXMM0.
claims.Limitations: No clamp in getter; actual per-category delay applies its resource minimum.

claims.Finding: Returns 1 + signed state+52/100 as float special-charge gain multiplier.
claims.Limitations: No native finite/range check; trainer preflights resulting float conversion and integer addition.

claims.Finding: For a lock-on category with flag1, computes timer=max(row+16,row+8 - current-player bonus44*row+12); otherwise uses row+4 initial timer.
claims.Limitations: Changing the bonus affects future timer reloads; it does not rewrite all already-running timers.

claims.Finding: Computes the same bonus-adjusted lock-on delay from a parameter row with the row minimum.
claims.Limitations: Readout/getter semantics; not a standalone time-advance action.

claims.Finding: With comboRCX/pointsEDX, resolves combo+8 ship then ship+200 state, multiplies points by state52 coefficient, truncates to signed integer and adds combo+56. Each100points adds stock+60 up to9; saturation sets progress100 and flag4.
claims.Limitations: Trainer ignores incidental RAX, bounds conversion/addition, keeps native full-latch behavior and does not reset the combo phase.

claims.Finding: Constructs the72-byte inline combo state, clearing ship pointers, counts, flags, stock and progress; initializes stage index5 when no stages exist.
claims.Limitations: This object has no vtable; ownership is established through the parent and exact main-ship/state backlinks.

claims.Finding: Scans a ship for sword-type installed parts, increments five main-ship stage counts and sets installation flag1; companion parts may enable flag1 without main-stage counts.
claims.Limitations: A fabricated enable flag is not equivalent to installing weapon resources.

claims.Finding: Consumes input requestflag2 and stock in phase0, then runs wait/fire/continue/finish/recovery phases1..5. Invokes native weapon IDs621,605..608 and eventually companion callbacks. Companion-only phase2/index5 increments the stage index to6 when entering phase4, retained through phase5 until reset.
claims.Limitations: The trainer only adds charge and preserves these phases; no raw phase setter or fake attack object is exposed.

claims.Finding: Binds main and optional companion GUMISHIP pointers, scans their installed sword parts, adds initial stock from state56 and initializes stage/timer.
claims.Limitations: Initial stock and stage configuration depend on the selected loadout.

claims.Finding: Reads combo stock at+60.
claims.Limitations: Valid trainer readout is0..9 on an installed current combo.

claims.Finding: Reads combo progress+56 as a float fraction divided by100.
claims.Limitations: Trainer exposes0..100progress units so100means one full charge unit.

claims.Finding: Returns GUMISHIP+200 authoritative PLAYER_STATE pointer.
claims.Limitations: A stale ship pointer is not made safe by this getter; trainer validates parent ownership before calling charge.

claims.Finding: Normal player reward path checks combo installation, obtains enemy parameter byte15 and adds it through230BD0.
claims.Limitations: Trainer command supplies explicit points, bypassing the need to kill that enemy but retains charge conversion.

claims.Finding: Looks up first matching ID in systemparam header count+4 with32-byte rows beginning+8.
claims.Limitations: No native count or null validation; trainer uses bounded readable traversal.

claims.Finding: Roll/bank-angle smoothing consumes the same mobility factor as movement, including tuning+24.
claims.Limitations: Mobility control changes handling as well as lateral speed; it is not an isolated forward travel-speed slider.

claims.Finding: Records a176-byte editor item snapshot in one of two groups, with1000entries per group and counters at28/32.
claims.Limitations: This is two before/after groups, not evidence of a1000-step undo stack.

claims.Finding: Recreates items from one HISTORY group by allocating2576-byte GUMI objects, constructing them and adding them to the current WORKAREA; temporarily changes editor mode.
claims.Limitations: Requires menu allocator, WORKAREA and retained item handles; not safe to invoke from the Gummi battle context.

claims.Finding: Removes current objects referenced by a selected HISTORY group from WORKAREA, switching temporary editor mode per item.
claims.Limitations: This is object destruction/replacement work, not a simple numerical rollback.

claims.Finding: Redo-direction helper removes group0 and recreates group1, then marks history side1. Corrected by gummi_round5_deep.json: WORKAREA caller265580 advances the history cursor before invoking this helper.
claims.Limitations: External editor ownership and retained pointer validity remain open.

claims.Finding: Undo-direction helper removes group1 and recreates group0, then marks history side0. Corrected by gummi_round5_deep.json: WORKAREA caller269B50 invokes this helper and then decrements the history cursor.
claims.Limitations: No independent runtime editor Undo/Redo feature is exposed until complete menu ownership gates are proved.

claims.Finding: Recomputes editor cost capacity from base limits and save-backed upgrade IDs170/171/175; special mode uses a separate capacity, and companion count36 contributes additional capacity.
claims.Limitations: Writing the displayed limit can be overwritten here and would not prove placement/save acceptance checks.

claims.Finding: Constructs embedded LOCKON and SIGHT objects at player+2960, using class5B5320 and initializing target slots.
claims.Limitations: An embedded address alone is insufficient; trainer checks the actual class and current parameter rows.

claims.Finding: Initializes four lock-on category timers by looking up128-byte lockonparam rows for IDs in5B51B8 and applying bonus44/minimum-delay formula.
claims.Limitations: Trainer validates the current row pointers against the loaded table; it does not rebuild target slots.

claims.Finding: Looks up first playerparam ID in128-byte rows; player constructor uses ID0 and stores it at player+1376.
claims.Limitations: Trainer verifies this exact current resource identity, not merely readable memory.

claims.Finding: Constructs the5136-byte current player including GUMISHIP, PLAYER_STATE, LOCKON, combo and DRAIN; binds input/tuning and publishes AF0540.
claims.Limitations: Global publication occurs during construction, so module and gameplay phases remain required.

claims.Finding: Target-acquisition loop checks each of four category timers and free sight slots, chooses eligible targets, creates targeting sprites and resets category delay.
claims.Limitations: Not called directly by the trainer: sprite allocation, target selection and owned sight lifetime remain native.

claims.Finding: LOCKON_GUN update delegates to GUN update, then clears completed sight references and optionally aligns effect orientation for weapon84.
claims.Limitations: Separate target-reference ownership prevents treating every gun as interchangeable cooldown memory.

claims.Finding: GUN destructor unlinks the object from a global packed-next160 list and optionally frees it through the Gummi allocator.
claims.Limitations: Global gun lists include more than the current player; a future per-gun controller must prove player-part ownership.

claims.Finding: Binds a gun to its owner, position/orientation, bone/parameter data and projectile type; clears burst/delay state.
claims.Limitations: Gun ownership and parameter references outlive this initializer; no trainer reinitialization is exposed.

claims.Finding: Alternative gun initialization uses default bone-1 and clears burst/delay state while copying attack parameters.
claims.Limitations: Initializer ABI has resource arguments; it is not a cooldown-reset API.

claims.Finding: Enables burst flag4, sets float interval128 fromXMM1, clears countdown132 and sets burst count147 fromR8B.
claims.Limitations: Zero/negative delay changes burst-loop behavior and can emit several projectiles in one update.

claims.Finding: Native gun delay setter writes XMM1float to base delay136 and remaining delay140.
claims.Limitations: Useful future candidate once a stable player-owned gun set is validated; not exposed through arbitrary pointers.

claims.Finding: Requests firing only when supplied selectorEDX equals gun byte144; sets requestflag1 and resets burst progress148 when burstflag4 is enabled.
claims.Limitations: Request is deferred to the gun update; it does not immediately prove a projectile spawned.

claims.Finding: Clears only the gun fire-request flag1.
claims.Limitations: Leaves cooldown and existing projectiles intact.

claims.Finding: DECOGUMI_GUN destruction walks the part-owned gun chain via packednext164, unlinks each and invokes its virtual destructor, then destroys/frees the part.
claims.Limitations: Per-gun actions need both part and gun lifetime checks, not only the global list.

claims.Finding: Initializes part gun behavior/owner references and updates model-space aiming; owner may be redirected according to part type.
claims.Limitations: Gun+56 alone is not a universal current-player ownership test.

scope_limits: No universal energy/overheat state identified in the inspected gun paths; no such toggle is claimed.
Per-gun cooldown330+ remains open until complete player-part/gun lifetime selection is implemented.
Editor History/Cost semantics are documented, but editor object/resource/placement/save lifecycle is not yet safe for mutation.
Main ship runtime controls do not edit design files or the save. Normal gameplay effects may still affect later mission results.
Immediate tuning products are validated; all later physics computations for arbitrarily modified assets are not claimed safe.
